meta.title: Edit Permissions for Articles
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Edit Permissions for Articles".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Edit Permissions for Articles', 'joomlaguide-article-permissions', '

Authors may write articles and edit their own; Editors may edit all articles; Publishers may also publish them. In this tour you try that with two test users on the site, while you stay logged in here as administrator.

Ready for you: the menu item Newsroom Submissions, only for registered users, and two users in the group Author:

  • Joe Bloggs: username joe, password joe-test-password
  • Erika Mustermann: username erika, password erika-test-password

This tour follows the tutorial 7.6 Edit Permissions for Articles of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_users","com_config"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 7.6 Edit Permissions for Articles', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Joe writes an article', '

Look at your site: click Site in the toolbar of the Joomla Playground. Newsroom Submissions is not in the Main Menu.

  1. Log in with the Login Form as joe (password joe-test-password). Now Newsroom Submissions is there: click it.
  2. Click New Article, type the title Local Bakery Wins Regional Award and click Save & Close.

The article is submitted, but not in the list: articles of authors start unpublished. Then come back to the administrator and click Next.

', 1, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 3, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Publish Joe\'s article', '

Click the grey cross of Local Bakery Wins Regional Award to publish it.

', 4, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" local-bakery-wins-regional-award"]) [data-item-task="articles.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Erika writes an article', '

On the site, as Joe:

  1. Reload Newsroom Submissions: Joe\'s article is there. Edit it, type Owner has been baking for the community since the bakery opened in 2001. and save.
  2. Create another article: Weekend Farmers Market Returns Downtown.
  3. Log out, and log in as erika (password erika-test-password). Erika sees Joe\'s article, but cannot edit it.
  4. As Erika, create the article New Bike Lanes Open Downtown.

Then come back here and click Next.

', 5, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Publish Erika\'s article', '

Click the grey cross of New Bike Lanes Open Downtown.

Do not publish Weekend Farmers Market Returns Downtown yet.

', 6, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" new-bike-lanes-open-downtown"]) [data-item-task="articles.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Authors edit their own articles', '

On the site, as Erika, reload Newsroom Submissions and edit New Bike Lanes Open Downtown: type Cyclists can now ride safely to downtown offices and businesses. The editor has fewer tools than in the administrator. Save the article.

Authors can create articles and see all published ones, but edit only their own. Next, you make Erika an Editor.

', 7, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Users', '

In the menu on the left, click Users.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 8, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_users&view=users"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Users › Manage', '

Click Manage in Users.

', 9, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_users&view=users"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Open Erika', '

Click Erika Mustermann.

', 10, 'right', '#userList a[title$=" Erika Mustermann"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=users', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Assigned User Groups', '

Click the Assigned User Groups tab.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-user button[aria-controls="groups"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Make Erika an Editor', '

Untick Author and tick Editor. Then click Next.

', 12, 'top', '.view-user #groups', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Save', '

Click Save: you come back to this form soon.

', 13, 'bottom', '.view-user .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Editors edit all articles', '

On the site, as Erika, reload Newsroom Submissions: now Weekend Farmers Market Returns Downtown shows too, as unpublished.

Edit it and type Fresh produce will be available on Saturday afternoons. On the Options tab, Status is Unpublished and Erika cannot change it. Save the article.

Then come back here and click Next.

', 14, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Make Erika a Publisher', '

On the Assigned User Groups tab, tick Publisher as well. Then click Next.

', 15, 'top', '.view-user #myTab', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Save the user', '

Click Save & Close.

', 16, 'bottom', '.view-user #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=user&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Publishers publish', '

On the site, as Erika, edit Weekend Farmers Market Returns Downtown: on the Options tab, set its Status to Published, and see that the editor has more tools now. Save it: the Unpublished badge is gone.

Log out, and log in as Joe again: he can see and edit the article now. Then come back here and click Next.

', 17, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=users', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 18, 'right', 'body.com_users.view-users #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=users', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 19, 'right', 'body.com_users.view-users #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_users&view=users', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Permissions of one article', '

Where do these rights come from? Click Local Bakery Wins Regional Award to edit it.

', 20, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" local-bakery-wins-regional-award"]) a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Permissions', '

Click the Permissions tab.

', 21, 'bottom', '.view-article button[aria-controls="permissions"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'The user groups', '

On the left are the user groups, on the right the permissions of the chosen one. All are Inherited from the settings for all articles.

  • Public: may not edit, delete or change the state of articles.
  • Click Author: may not edit this article. (Joe could edit it as its author: more about that soon.)
  • Click Editor: may edit it.
  • Click Publisher: may edit it and change its state, that is, publish it.

You could change these permissions for this one article. Then click Next.

', 22, 'top', '.view-article #permissions-sliders', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Close the article', '

Click Close.

', 23, 'bottom', '.view-article .button-cancel', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Permissions of all articles', '

Click Options.

', 24, 'left', '.view-articles .button-options', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Permissions', '

Click the Permissions tab.

', 25, 'bottom', '.com_config button[aria-controls="permissions"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Edit Own', '

These are the permissions all articles inherit.

Click Author: authors may not edit articles in general, but they may Create articles and Edit Own: edit the articles they created. That is why Joe and Erika could edit their own articles.

Then click Next.

', 26, 'top', '.com_config #permissions-sliders', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-permissions'), 'Well done!', '

You have seen how authors, editors and publishers work together, and where their permissions are set.

Click Close to leave the options without changes.

', 27, 'center', '', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
